counting_rule: Each non-import AST top-level node appears once; decorator lines are included with functions; source bytes exclude comments between statements; import estimate includes original imports, cross-module references, and a reserve.
census_method: The listed searches locate candidates. Python ast resolves reckon.cli import aliases, member attribute loads, and patch calls; direct source-path reads and Click registry writers are then checked against the cited lines. The worker run transcript contains the classification command.
